name: govern_memory
description: Writes temporary candidates, knowledge decisions or handoffs. suggest: kind=memory|rule|relation; memory requires category/content/source. Distill jobs: suggest, then finalize (do not decide early). Include distill_job_id, evidence_basis, verification_outcome and typed verification_refs; runtime derives Answer Gate, only ANSWERED can write truth. Also require assimilation_disposition and assimilation_reason; add/refine/replace require canonical_title and topic_path as whole-name JSON array, NEVER path string. confirm/refine/replace select exact current target_knowledge=[{title,statement,module}] from normal search (title or statement required; module optional); confirm may reuse its unchanged statement. Unresolved targets retain old memory and unfinished work; independent valid points may save. Internal IDs remain compatible for existing callers but must not be requested from users. decide: kind=knowledge, decision=confirm|reject, project_name, candidate_id, explicit disposition. Delete: decision=delete, project_name and exactly one target_knowledge selection; omit candidate_id/knowledge_items. Replacement deletes old current truth, not history. Candidates are not legacy MemoryEntry truth. Evidence basis/ref kind: repository|user_statement|transcript|source_report, NEVER session_exchange. source_report records only what an authenticated source speaker reported, not external current truth or user approval; use exchange_index, digest and speaker role. User refs need exchange_index + returned content_sha256, no transcript locator. Refs accept kind/locator/content_sha256/exchange_index/chunk_index/role, not source/job IDs. handoff requires project_name/task_id/summary/status and distill_job_id for distill work.

arguments.description: Action-specific arguments; project_name is required for project writes.

kind.description: Existing action kind: memory, rule, relation or knowledge.

project_name.description: Context label returned by the selected job/target.

content.description: The narrow candidate statement, required for memory suggestions.

source.description: Required source explanation for memory suggestions.

distill_job_id.description: Returned job binding; required for distill suggestions.

assimilation_disposition.description: add, refine, confirm, replace, no_write, handoff, defer, conflict or reject.

canonical_title.description: Exact field name for the knowledge title; NOT title.

topic_path.description: JSON array of whole category names; never a path string.

items.description: Integrity reference used by Dream admission, never evidence content.

locator.description: Transient project-relative repository path. Source/session refs use the owning distill job instead of storing a raw locator.
locator.title: Locator

items.title: EvidenceRef

verification_refs.description: Exact typed source references; user statements use kind=user_statement, exchange_index and the returned exchange digest.

target_knowledge.description: Exact old memory text from ordinary search; no user-managed identifiers.

project_name.description: Optional unchanged context label returned by ordinary search.
